responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s format-string parsing data model and FFI boundary for `format_args!` handling. It defines the low-level `ffi` structs that mirror parsed formatting concepts such as positions, counts, format specs, arguments, and pieces, declares the external parser/clone/destroy entry points, and exposes the higher-level `Fmt::Pieces` RAII wrapper that frontend AST code uses to hold parsed template pieces safely on the C++ side.
same_name_distinction: Defines the FFI-facing format-string data structures and declares the external parser and `Fmt::Pieces` wrapper, while the same-stem `.cc` file implements the wrapper’s collection, copy/move, destruction, and string-conversion behavior.
